name: Getinge AB (publ)
summary: Getinge AB (publ) provides products and solutions for operating rooms, intensive-care units, and sterilization departments in Sweden and internationally. The company operates through Acute Care Therapies, Life Science, and Surgical Workflows segments. It offers extracorporeal membrane oxygenation, mechanical ventilation, advanced patient monitoring, ICU infrastructure equipment, and drainage solutions.
